condition: 3. 固定30会話で独話loop・反復collapseを起こさない

control_emitted_ratio.note: The calibration report said that if the control itself tripped the monologue threshold the THRESHOLD would be wrong, not the candidate. It does not.

control_repeat_collapse.consequence: J-Moshi-ext itself fails the absolute form of condition 3 on 2 of 30, so 'no worse than the control' is the honest frame and the absolute bar is reported alongside it.

finding.headline: V-real degrades into silence as training proceeds; V-tts does not.
finding.reading: Speaker A in V-real is 8.67 minutes across 72 sentences. Five epochs over that is enough to push the model toward saying nothing at all - by epoch 5 it is silent on 24 of 50 prompts. The same schedule on V-tts, whose channel A is synthetic but otherwise identical in scripts, split, speaker B and timeline, stays at 12%.
finding.caveat: This does not isolate 'real versus synthetic audio'. V-tts's channel A is also more uniform - one TTS voice with consistent loudness and no recording-session variation - and that uniformity may be what the model tolerates, not the synthesis itself.

status: met by v-tts epoch 2 and epoch 5
limits: Silence is scored from the text stream. A generation that emits no text is flagged, which is the intended behaviour: saying nothing is not health.
Partner-channel activity is deliberately excluded, being teacher-forced and therefore vacuous.
